events.title: [WEBINAR] Advanced Certificate in Law and Technology Module 2: Essentials of LegalTech - Digitalisating Legal Work+
events.outline: This module covers all the basic know-how you need to start implementing the 21st Century Office ASAP, from explaining how the various technologies work and how to apply them, to how culture is both the cultural glue and foundation from which the 21st Century Office can take off from.

events.title: ABA CJS’s Global White Collar Crime Institute+
events.outline: During this one-and-a-half-day conference in Singapore, cutting edge issues in the field of international white collar crime will be examined and discussed and participants will learn about international white collar criminal laws and issues that matter most to their practices in 2026 and beyond.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Senior Counsel Forum 2026 - Module 1: How to Make Good Submissions
events.outline: The Senior Counsel Forum, by the Law Society of Singapore, returns with six modules led by distinguished Senior Counsel. Topics include court submissions, duty to the court, disciplinary processes, conflicts of interest, common ethical scenarios, and English ethics practice. An invaluable opportunity for lawyers to learn best practices in legal ethics, delivered virtually via Zoom.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Community Law Training Programme 2026 - Module 3: Divorce Part 3: Financial Issues
events.outline: Financial issues are often the most contentious and anxiety-inducing aspect of divorce, particularly in community, pro bono and low-bono matters where clients may have limited resources, incomplete information, or significant financial power imbalances.

events.title: [WEBINAR] The Human Right to Peace: Past, Present, Future
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. This webinar examines the right to peace as a human right recognised in international, regional, and domestic legal frameworks. Despite this recognition, uncertainty remains regarding its legal status, content, and implementation. Against the backdrop of ongoing armed conflicts worldwide, participants will explore the development of the right, contemporary legal approaches, its role in strengthening the international legal order, and ways to advance it as an enforceable legal entitlement.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Damages in Commercial Disputes: The Supreme Court Rewrites the Rules - And What It Means for Singapore
events.outline: This session examines One Step (Support) Ltd v Morris-Garner [2018] UKSC 20, a landmark Supreme Court ruling on negotiating damages in contract law. The decision limits when claimants may seek damages assessed by reference to a defendant's release price, leaving open questions for English commercial law. Given shared common law roots, the case is directly relevant to Singapore practitioners. The session pairs English authority with local analysis, exploring how Singapore courts have engaged with the same issues.

events.title: [WEBINAR] ACRA's Prescribed Anti-Money Laundering Combating the Financing of Terrorism ("AML/CFT") Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Chartered Secretaries Institute Singapore (CSIS). This course intends to equip [Registered Filing Agents (RFAs)] with the knowledge and understanding of anti-money laundering (AML) and counter financing of terrorism (CFT) to enable RFAs to comply with prevailing ACRA and relevant Singapore’s regulatory requirements.

events.title: LawNet Training Workshop (15 July 2026)
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3 Room, The Adelphi, #07-01, 1 Coleman Street S179803
events.outline: This training workshop guides attendees through the new features and functionalities of LawNet.com. Through walkthroughs and hands-on exercises, participants will learn how to use the revamped platform efficiently

events.title: ESG Litigation: Risks and Impacts
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This module aims to equip legal counsel with the ability to understand and identify the risks and impacts posed by ESG-related disputes and litigation, and the strategies to manage and mitigate such risks and impacts. By the end of the course, they will be able to anticipate and manage the impacts and risks associated with ESG-related litigation and develop the ability to advise their organisations and clients on these risks and proactively defend and minimise these risks their organisations and clients may be exposed to.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 3: Advocacy Before Trial: Making the Most of Representations and CCMS
events.outline: This module equips defence counsel with practical strategies to draft persuasive representations and engage effectively in CCMS as a tool for early case resolution, pre-trial discovery, and plea negotiations.

events.title: [WEBINAR] SIArb Regional Webinar: Third-Party Funding in Arbitration
events.outline: SIArb’s Regional Webinar on “Third-Party Funding in Arbitration” examines the evolving role of TPF in international arbitration. The session covers funding structures, strategic considerations, regulatory frameworks across key jurisdictions, and legal issues such as disclosure, conflicts of interest, security for costs, and adverse costs exposure. Participants will gain practical insights into navigating funded disputes effectively.

events.title: CIL’s Dialogue with Japan’s Ambassador Ishikawa Hiroshi
events.venue: NUS Bukit Timah Campus, Block B, 469 Bukit Timah Road, Singapore 259756
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. CIL’s Dialogue with Japan’s Ambassador Ishikawa Hiroshi on Japan’s evolving roles in the region and beyond, and the updated “Free and Open Indo-Pacific”.

events.title: STEP Singapore Symposium: “Passing the Torch: Designing a Sustainable Family Enterprise and Legacy”
events.venue: Meeting Room, Level 3, West Tower Marine One, 9 Straits View, Singapore 018937
events.outline: This event is organised by STEP (Singapore Branch). Recent high profile family disputes publicised in the media have once again highlighted the importance of family governance and planning in advance. At this Symposium, expert family governance advisors from various disciplines share their experience to equip participants with basic awareness, foundational knowledge and tools when advising clients on of family governance. The Symposium includes an interactive workshop, where participants can apply learning points to a hypothetical case study.

events.title: Pacifica Congress Annual Conference 2026 - One World, Same Issues in Family Law+
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Pacifica Congress and the Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) are delighted to announce that our 2026 Annual Conference will be held in Singapore from 15 to 17 July 2026. Under the theme “One World, Same Issues in Family Law” this international event will bring together leading practitioners, academics, and judicial officers from across the Asia-Pacific and beyond to explore the shared challenges, innovations, and human stories at the heart of modern family law practice.

events.title: JLP - Acquiring Practical Skills in Contract Drafting (July 2026)+
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Learn ethical considerations, key drafting principles, and the use of commercial precedents and boilerplate clauses. Focus on enhancing clarity, avoiding pitfalls, and structuring contracts for better enforceability and value.

events.title: International Tax Law and Policy+
events.venue: Tax Academy of Singapore Hub, 55 Newton Road, Singapore 307987
events.outline: This event is organised by Tax Academy of Singapore. International Tax Law and Policy is an intensive three-day, in-person course offering a practice-oriented, policy-focused introduction to the legal and policy architecture of cross-border taxation. It is designed for tax professionals, policymakers, academics, and advanced students, and equips participants to navigate, from a tax policy perspective, the fast-evolving landscape of international tax rules, from core concepts to cutting-edge global reforms.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Small & Medium Firms – Business Planning, Marketing and Client Development
events.outline: Running a law practice demands more than legal expertise - it requires business planning, marketing, and client development. This session combines the College of Law's practice management expertise with insights from an experienced Singapore practitioner, offering practical strategies to define your firm's direction, strengthen market presence, and build a steady client pipeline. Designed for sole practitioners, small, and medium-sized firms, walk away with actionable insights for sustainable growth in Singapore's competitive legal market.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Community Law Training Programme 2026 - Module 4: Divorce Part 4: Post Divorce Issues
events.outline: This module focuses on the key issues that arise after divorce proceedings, including appeals, variation of orders, enforcement challenges and post-divorce support. Using a practitioner-led and community-law focused approach, this module equips participants to advise clients realistically on available post-divorce options, assess feasibility in pro bono contexts, and identify appropriate next steps. The session also examines enforcement and post-divorce challenges faced by transnational families, including cases involving significant financial disparity, as well as the limits of legal intervention and the importance of non-legal support.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Specialist Arbitration Series: Energy, Oil & Gas Arbitrations (Virtual Edition)
events.outline: Arbitration has become the preferred method of dispute resolution for a wide range of commercial disputes. The Specialist Arbitration Series seeks to shine the spotlight on the different areas of arbitration disputes, the major stakeholders, contractual relationships, key legal principles and types of claims and defences that are typically brought in that area, as well as the issues and strategic considerations to take note of in each stage of the arbitration for that particular area of dispute.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Beyond Instinct: Evidence-Based Negotiation for Legal Practice
events.outline: Negotiation is one of the most important skills in legal practice. This webinar introduces lawyers to contemporary, evidence-based insights that can help them become more adaptable and effective negotiators across a range of legal contexts.

events.title: Drafting CPF Division Orders: Getting It Right
events.outline: This seminar brings together experienced family law practitioners and representatives from the CPF Board to guide you through the key considerations and best practices in drafting court orders for the division of CPF-related matrimonial assets. Gain direct insight into how the CPF Board approaches and processes these orders, alongside practical perspectives from practitioners who deal with these issues day to day.

events.title: JLP - Dealing with Practical Issues in Due Diligence (22 July 2026)
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Learn the legal due diligence process, manage risks, avoid common pitfalls, and prepare comprehensive reports with risk management recommendations.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Targeting and Effects in Dual-Use Space Systems
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. Outer space is vital to modern military, economic, and civilian activities. Satellites support communications, navigation, finance, emergency response, and defence operations, often serving both civilian and military functions. This webinar examines the legal challenges arising from the targeting of dual-use space systems during armed conflict, focusing on military objectives, proportionality, civilian protection, and the application of international humanitarian law.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 4: Conducting Effective Pleas of Guilt
events.outline:
A guilty plea is more than a procedural step—it carries serious consequences for the client’s future. How can defence counsel ensure the plea is made knowingly, voluntarily, and with full understanding?
This seminar will equip criminal defence lawyers with the tools to navigate the legal and ethical landscape of guilty pleas. Learn when and how to advise clients, what they must understand before pleading, and how to support them even after sentencing.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Introduction to the International Climate Change Legal Regime (UNFCCC and Paris Agreement)
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. This lecture introduces the international legal framework on climate change through the UNFCCC, the Kyoto Protocol, and the Paris Agreement. It examines their development, key obligations, and the principles of international cooperation, equity, differentiated responsibilities, transparency, and implementation. The session also explores the achievements, limitations, and policy relevance of these agreements, providing a foundation for understanding contemporary global climate governance.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (23 July)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: The Value Adjustment Mechanism (“Dui Du”) in Equity Investment Agreements in China
events.outline: This masterclass examines Value Adjustment Mechanisms (VAMs) in China’s equity market, focusing on their commercial purpose, role in risk allocation, and changing legal and regulatory landscape. The session concludes by reviewing recent cases and enforcement trends.

events.title: [WEBINAR] ALB Contentious Issues in International Commercial Agreements Masterclass 2026+
events.outline: The biggest problems in international commercial agreements often come from a small set of clauses: liability, damages, indemnities, "consequential loss," force majeure, hardship, and dispute provisions. This masterclass is built to help participants anticipate where deals go wrong, combining clear legal principles with hands-on clause work so participants can draft with greater precision, and negotiate risk allocation with confidence.

events.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Conference 2026
events.venue: Sands Expo & Convention Centre, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore 10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore 018956
events.outline: The Cybersecurity and Data Protection Conference 2026 brings together leading practitioners, regulators, and industry experts to examine key developments at the intersection of law and technology. Featuring sessions on AI, data sharing, cybersecurity incidents, and health data, the conference will also include a keynote address by Denise Wong, Commissioner of Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Commission, and opportunities for in-depth discussion with speakers.

events.title: China, Hong Kong & Asia: The New Capital Markets and M&A Order
events.venue: 80RR Fintech Hub SG, 80 Robinson Road, #08-01, Singapore 068898
events.outline: This event is organised by RHT Academy Pte. Ltd. As Asia becomes the centre of global capital flows and investment, this session explores the legal and regulatory developments shaping cross-border capital markets and M&A across China, Hong Kong and ASEAN. Participants will gain practical insights into transaction structuring, regulatory approvals, due diligence, compliance, ESG, digital assets, and strategies for navigating an increasingly Asia-centric dealmaking environment.

events.title: ISDA Masterclass: Derivatives Documentation+
events.venue: voco Orchard Singapore, 581 Orchard Rd, Singapore 238883
events.outline: This event is organised by International Swaps and Derivatives Association, Inc. (ISDA). This comprehensive two-day course will introduce you to the key uses and risks of derivatives and provide an in-depth review of the foundational documents related to derivatives transactions. You will learn to identify key elements of derivatives documents, gain an understanding of key considerations when negotiating these documents, and learn how to use the ISDA Create platform to turn those negotiations into legal documents.

events.title: JLP - An Introduction to Navigating ESG
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Get a comprehensive understanding of ESG issues and the legal frameworks surrounding them, with a focus on practical applications and the challenges they may encounter in their legal practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Business and Property Valuations Essentials for Litigation Lawyers
events.outline: Valuation evidence is pivotal in disputes over shareholder rights, damages, insolvency, and property. This webinar, led by valuation and litigation experts, gives litigators practical insight into where valuations go wrong, from flawed assumptions and misapplied International Valuation Standards to poor expert timing and weak cross-examination prep. Participants will learn to instruct experts effectively, spot methodology risks early, and engage with valuation evidence more strategically throughout the dispute lifecycle.

events.title: Shaping the Future of Personal Injury Law: Technology, Risk and Reform
events.venue: Havelock Hall, B2, State Courts of Singapore, 1 Havelock Square, Singapore 059724
events.outline: This year’s programme will examine product liability and personal injury claims arising from digital commerce, complex supply chains, and emerging technologies, followed by an overview of the Ministry of Law’s AI Guidelines and the responsible use of AI in the context of PIPD practice

events.title: JLP - Cross-border Contract Drafting and Negotiation
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Get introduced to cross-border contracts and civil law concepts, with a focus on cross-cultural communication and negotiation. Learn to review contracts for legal coherence and gain practical advice on managing cross-border agreements.

events.title: CIL-NUS ASEAN Distinguished Lecture 2026 by Professor Mari Elka Pangestu
events.venue: Ngee Ann Kongsi Auditorium, NUS Education Resource Centre - NUS UCI
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. ASEAN faces growing challenges from geopolitical rivalry, economic fragmentation, supply chain disruptions, rapid AI advancement, and climate risks. To remain resilient and relevant, it must strengthen regional stability, economic integration, and cooperation in trade, energy, and digital governance while ensuring inclusive growth. Professor Mari Elka Pangestu will discuss the strategic choices ASEAN must make to deliver tangible benefits in an increasingly uncertain world.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Navigating Cross-border Dispute Resolution in Indonesia: Where Law Meets Reality
events.outline: Designed for Singapore lawyers handling cross-border disputes with an Indonesian dimension, this programme draws on frontline practitioner and academic experience from both jurisdictions. The session unpacks the Indonesian dispute resolution process from first principles: how the judicial system is structured, how disputes are managed, what friction arises, what choices exist in drafting a dispute resolution clause, and what happens when enforcement of an award or judgment is sought in Indonesian courts.

events.title: JLP - Applying Tech Law in Practice
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Learn about ethical issues in tech law, cybersecurity, PDPA, and e-commerce law in Singapore. Explore data protection regulations and notable developments in AI.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Community Law Training Programme 2026 - Module 5: Syariah Divorces
events.outline: This module focuses on the key issues that arise when assisting clients in Syariah divorce proceedings, including marriages entered into overseas and the resulting need to understand foreign jurisdictions and collate documentation. This module also provides practical procedural guidance on proceedings in the Syariah Court, equipping participants with a clearer understanding of how such matters are navigated in practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] IWIRC x Acrostics Asia Panel on Southeast Asia Restructuring Evolution
events.venue: Webinar / Stephenson Harwood (Singapore) Alliance Office, 8 Marina Boulevard #29-01, Tower 1 Marina Bay Financial Centre, Singapore 018981
events.outline: This event is organised by IWIRC Singapore. This seminar will deal with the notable developments in the Southeast Asia’s restructuring and insolvency landscape over the past year (including Vietnam’s new law that prioritises rehabilitation, Malaysia’s move to align its insolvency framework with international practices, and an agreement between the Supreme Courts of Singapore and Indonesia for greater coordination) and the potential implications for investors, borrowers and restructuring professionals.

events.title: Ethical Considerations Arising from AI Use in Legal Practice
events.venue: Dentons Rodyk & Davidson LLP, 80 Raffles Place #33-00 UOB Plaza 1, Singapore 048624
events.outline: This event is organised by Dentons Rodyk & Davidson LLP. AI use has been heralded as a game changer for legal practice, with suggestions that the lawyer who does not use AI will be left behind. In the rush, we must not lose sight of our ethical obligations. This session is a refresher of those obligations in the AI era.

events.title: Global Disputes Summit – Singapore Edition
events.venue: WongPartnership; 12 Marina Boulevard, Level 28 Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3, Singapore 018982
events.outline: This event is organised by Global Disputes Summit. To provide legal and dispute resolution professionals with practical insights into emerging challenges in international disputes, arbitration, and cross-border commercial risk management through expert-led discussions and case-based analysis.

events.title: Scott Schedule Workshop 2026
events.venue: Pinsent Masons MPillay LLP, 182 Cecil St, #32-01 Frasers Tower, Singapore 069547
events.outline: This event is organised by Asia Pacific Institute of Experts (APIEx). Built around a realistic construction scenario from construction stage to dispute resolution on the merits, this workshop provides contract administrators with a broader more practical perspective on Scott Schedules

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 5: Mental Health in the Courtroom: Navigating Conditions, Defences & Vulnerabilities
events.outline:
Not every mental condition changes the legal outcome and some may do so in surprising ways. This module equips lawyers to better identify psychiatric and psychological conditions in clients and understand their legal implications.
Learn how to work with forensic psychiatrists, interpret reports, and support vulnerable witnesses. We’ll also explore the growing role of social workers and intermediaries in enhancing justice outcomes.

events.title: IT LAW SERIES: Leveraging Technology Tools in the Legal Sector
events.outline: This seminar series aims to provide participants with an overview of some of the latest IT law issues and developments. Every session focuses on a different topic and will be conducted by a variety of leading practitioners and academics in the relevant field, who will deliver presentations and participate in a Q&A discussion with opportunities for participants to pose questions.

events.title: Foundation Mediation Training - Module 2: Negotiation in Action
events.venue: PracticeForte Resolution Space, 70 Shenton Way, #11-13/14/15 Eon Shenton, Singapore 079118
events.outline: This event is organised by PracticeForte Pte. Ltd. This workshop equips participants with practical negotiation through both theory and application. Led by Joel Lee, a leading Singapore authority in negotiation and mediation, the session introduces the Harvard Seven Elements of Negotiation and the ATNA framework. Participants will learn how to assess leverage, manage conflict, and identify pathways to effective and principled agreement.

events.title: Foundation Mediation Training+
events.venue: PracticeForte Resolution Space, 70 Shenton Way, #11-13/14/15 Eon Shenton, Singapore 079118
events.outline: This event is organised by PracticeForte Pte. Ltd. Conflicts are inevitable in life, but how we approach and resolve them defines relationships, communities, and businesses. Designed to equip you with the mindset, skills, and structured processes to turn conflict into opportunity, this six-day immersive workshop brings together a multidisciplinary team of trainers with decades of expertise in law, cross-cultural negotiation, and professional mediation, empowering you to contribute meaningfully in mediating disputes in any context.

events.title: Advanced Certificate in Law and Technology Module 9: Digital Assets and IP Disputes+
events.outline: This module delves into IP laws and applying it to digital assets. Participants will acquire the knowledge to making proper considerations in managing and disputing IP matters. They will also learn how to manage digital assets and understand the application of IP law in this digital age.

events.title: [WEBINAR] International Arbitration in Practice 2026 - Session 1: Navigating Early Stages of Arbitration
events.outline: This session explores the critical early stages of arbitration, from drafting and responding to Notices of Arbitration to constituting the arbitral tribunal and setting procedural directions. It highlights key strategic considerations, institutional requirements, and practical issues that may affect timelines, costs, efficiency, and jurisdiction. Participants will gain practical guidance on navigating the first steps of arbitration effectively.

events.title: Foundation Mediation Training - Module 4: The Mediation Process
events.venue: PracticeForte Resolution Space, 70 Shenton Way, #11-13/14/15 Eon Shenton, Singapore 079118
events.outline: This event is organised by PracticeForte Pte. Ltd. This module maps how mediation actually unfolds. It introduces the Seven Stages and four phases— Begin, Information Gathering, Problem Solving, Resolution—showing how cases move, stall, and regain momentum. Participants then craft and deliver opening statements, with feedback on trust, tone, and framing. The session ends with a faculty-led fishbowl, where experienced mediators are observed handling a full mediation in real time.

events.title: Foundation Mediation Training - Module 3: Understanding Mediation
events.venue: PracticeForte Resolution Space, 70 Shenton Way, #11-13/14/15 Eon Shenton, Singapore 079118
events.outline: This event is organised by PracticeForte Pte. Ltd. This hands-on module immerses participants in guided live mediation exercises before any formal teaching begins. Through role plays and faculty-led review, participants explore mediation principles, mediator styles, party dynamics, and the effectiveness of mediation as a dispute resolution process. The session builds practical skills, sharpens critical thinking, and provides a concrete framework for future practice.

events.title: Foundation Mediation Training - Module 6: Mediation Toolkit II
events.venue: PracticeForte Resolution Space, 70 Shenton Way, #11-13/14/15 Eon Shenton, Singapore 079118
events.outline: This event is organised by PracticeForte Pte. Ltd. When mediation gets difficult, process skills matter. This session equips participants to handle power imbalances, manage impasse, and keep conversations productive. Drawing on real case experience, Susan Tay and Marcus Lim share strategies for building client trust and managing threats to the mediation process.

events.title: Foundation Mediation Training - Module 5: Mediation Toolkit I
events.venue: PracticeForte Resolution Space, 70 Shenton Way, #11-13/14/15 Eon Shenton, Singapore 079118
events.outline: This event is organised by PracticeForte Pte. Ltd. Great mediators are skilled communicators first. This module builds core interpersonal skills: active listening, purposeful reframing, rapport-building, and strategic questioning techniques. Through practical exercises and demonstrations, participants develop communication habits that define exceptional mediators.

events.title: Foundation Mediation Training - Module 8: Mediation Ethics
events.venue: PracticeForte Resolution Space, 70 Shenton Way, #11-13/14/15 Eon Shenton, Singapore 079118
events.outline: This event is organised by PracticeForte Pte. Ltd. Ethical practice is not just rule-following — it is judgment under pressure. This module explores mediators' core ethical obligations, the SIMI Code of Professional Conduct, and the management of confidentiality and impartiality. Case scenarios build the nuanced decision-making skills every professional mediator needs.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Advanced Certificate in Law and Technology Module 6: Legal Issues in AI and Machine Learning+
events.outline: This module provides an overview of machine learning technology and dives into key terminology that will help participants navigate through legal issues in artificial intelligence. Participants will also dive deeper in the impacts of AI and its regulations, to better understand the power of AI and the magnitude that comes with it.

events.title: JLP - Understanding Business of Law+
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Learn how to position law firms and practice areas effectively, understand the fundamentals of the business of law, develop skills to become a trusted adviser, and master client pitch techniques.

events.title: Force Majeure In Maritime Force Majeure In Maritime Contracts: Grey Areas, Contracts: Grey Areas, Claims And Disputes
events.outline: This event is organised by Singapore Chamber of Maritime Arbitration (SCMA). Recent geopolitical tensions and conflicts have disrupted global supply chains, trade routes and energy markets, leading to an increase in force majeure declarations across the shipping,petrochemical and commodities sectors. As parties grapple with contractual obligations amid uncertainty, questions continue to arise over when force majeure can legitimately be invoked and how disputes should be resolved.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Senior Counsel Forum 2026 - Module 2: Duty to the Court: An Officer and A Lawyer
events.outline: The Senior Counsel Forum, by the Law Society of Singapore, returns with six modules led by distinguished Senior Counsel. Topics include court submissions, duty to the court, disciplinary processes, conflicts of interest, common ethical scenarios, and English ethics practice. An invaluable opportunity for lawyers to learn best practices in legal ethics, delivered virtually via Zoom.

events.title: A Practical Workshop in Building and Construction Dispute Resolution+
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: The course covers contentious issues that regularly occur in building construction projects and disputes: payments and variations; time and delays and termination. It also covers other practical aspects of the built industry such as construction programmes. Each session covers the legal principles and developments pertaining to these issues with a tutorial thereafter.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Community Law Training Programme 2026 - Module 6: Invisible Disabilities
events.outline:
This module focuses on how lawyers and practitioners can better recognise and respond to invisible disabilities when assisting clients in community, pro bono and low-bono settings. Adopting a practical and community-law focused approach, the session explores how invisible disabilities may present in family and community law cases, and how inclusive, trauma-informed practices can improve access to justice.
This session is designed for practitioners working in community legal clinics and family law matters involving vulnerable clients.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Urgent Interim Relief in Insolvency Proceedings and Clawback Actions
events.outline: When speed is essential, the Singapore Courts can grant urgent interim relief in insolvency matters. This seminar covers key tools including provisional liquidation, interim judicial management, interim receivership in bankruptcy, moratoriums in scheme proceedings, injunctive relief in clawback actions, and court ordered receivership. It also examines key principles, practical considerations, and common pitfalls in making or opposing such applications.

events.title: LawNet Training Workshop (5 August 2026)
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street S(179803)
events.outline: This training workshop guides attendees through the new features and functionalities of LawNet.com. Through walkthroughs and hands-on exercises, participants will learn how to use the revamped platform efficiently

events.title: How Experts can contribute in the Valuation of Damages for Financial Misconduct cases
events.outline: This event is organised by GAO Capital Pte. Ltd.. The seminar will cover how valuation experts can assist the court by providing independent valuation of damages for financial misconduct cases, and the appropriate Fit & Proper standards for Fund Managers and Financial Firms when exclusive material information is involved.

events.title: Certificate in Family Office & Governance
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This module introduces the family office landscape, core functions, and role within the private wealth ecosystem. It covers family governance structures, constitutions, councils, ownership and board dynamics, and alignment of values and roles. Participants also examine family dynamics, cultural influences, conflict management, and the legal professional’s role, supported by case studies and practical discussions.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 6: Mastering Expert Witnesses: Duties, Standards, and Cross-Examination
events.outline:
Expert witnesses play a crucial role in court, but their duties and standards differ significantly from ordinary witnesses. What are the key expectations for expert evidence to be deemed reliable and useful?
Learn from experienced professionals to sharpen your skills in handling expert testimony in criminal cases.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Paris Agreement: Implementation and Compliance
events.outline: This webinar is organised by NUS - Centre for International Law. This lecture will examine the Paris Agreement Implementation and Compliance Committee (PAICC), established under Article 15 of the Paris Agreement. It will explore the similarities and differences between the PAICC and compliance mechanisms under earlier multilateral environmental agreements. The lecture will also assess the PAICC’s contributions to global climate change efforts since the Paris Agreement entered into force.

events.title: Criminal Practice 101: Mentions Court Matters
events.venue: Members' Lounge (The Law Society of Singapore), 28 Maxwell Road, #01-03, Singapore 069120
events.outline: This session is aimed at lawyers who are new to criminal practice and want a practical overview of how the mentions courts work. Participants will be taken through everything from the basics of what the mentions court is, who is in the room, and how to get your matter called, to the more substantive aspects of managing a criminal case through the mentions stage, including bail applications and applications to leave jurisdiction.

events.title: Where Psychiatry Meets The Law: Duties On Legal Practitioners And Psychiatrists When Adducing Psychiatric Evidence In Criminal Proceedings
events.venue: SUSS Room at the State Courts
events.outline: In the context of the Criminal Procedure (Expert Opinion) Rules 2025 and the legal principles that the High Court and Court of Appeal have laid down in recent cases, this seminar will discuss the professional and ethical duties on prosecutors, defence counsel and psychiatrists when adducing psychiatric evidence in criminal proceedings, so that the psychiatric assessment is accurate, comprehensive and objective, and the psychiatric evidence is cogent, defensible and helpful to the Court.

events.title: [WEBINAR] International Arbitration In Practice 2026 - Session 2: Document Production in Arbitration
events.outline: This session examines document production in international arbitration, covering its purpose, scope, and key principles such as relevance, proportionality, and efficiency. Through lectures, panel discussions, and a practical workshop, participants will explore common and civil law approaches, arbitral standards including the IBA Rules, ethical issues, and practical tools such as eDiscovery platforms and Redfern Schedules. The session concludes with an interactive drafting exercise and live feedback from practitioners.

events.title: JLP - Discovery and Document Management
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Learn how to maintain professional ethics, implement strategies for efficient document review and management, leverage technology, and draft discovery plans.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Senior Counsel Forum 2026 - Module 3: Disciplinary Process and Disciplinary Cases: Don’t Get Charged
events.outline: The Senior Counsel Forum, by the Law Society of Singapore, returns with six modules led by distinguished Senior Counsel. Topics include court submissions, duty to the court, disciplinary processes, conflicts of interest, common ethical scenarios, and English ethics practice. An invaluable opportunity for lawyers to learn best practices in legal ethics, delivered virtually via Zoom.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Community Law Training Programme 2026 - Module 7: Mental Capacity Matters, Wills & Probate
events.outline: This module focuses on the practical issues encountered when advising clients on mental capacity, estate planning and post-death matters in community, pro bono and low-bono settings. The session covers situations involving persons who lack mental capacity, including deputyship applications, as well as common challenges faced when managing wills and probate matters for vulnerable clients and families.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Building a Professional Brand and Delivering an Impactful Pitch for Legal Professionals (Session 2)
events.outline: This exclusive three-part webinar series is designed to equip legal professionals with the tools, mindset, and strategies to build a compelling personal brand, show up authentically in every interaction, and deliver pitches that win mandates and open doors.

events.title: PIPEs: Applying the Magic of Mediation to IP Disputes: Commercial Outcomes & Ethical Considerations
events.outline:
With the growing complexity and increasing number of international commercial disputes, including in the field of IP and technology, how has mediation floated up as an unlikely dark horse in providing a potentially effective dispute resolution process? 
Join us for a deep dive session exploring practical issues in mediation from the perspectives of disputants, legal counsel and mediator.

events.title: [WEBINAR] People, Pitfalls, and Practice: Managing Interpersonal Challenges in Law
events.outline: In this webinar, participants will learn why challenging behaviors arise, gain greater awareness of their own triggers and default responses, and learn practical strategies to navigate difficult conversations with colleagues, supervisors, and clients.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Decoding Trump’s Tariffs Policy: Method in the Madness
events.outline: This seminar will revisit the Liberation Day tariffs one year on, unpacking both their original rationale and their real-world consequences. The session will examine the political-economic logic driving the policy, analyze responses from key actors, especially China, and explore how the emerging bilateral deals are reshaping global trade governance in ways that remain under-appreciated.

events.title: [WEBINAR] E154: Anti-Money Laundering / Combating The Financing Of Terrorism (“AML / CFT”) Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA). The course is designed to enable RFAs to demonstrate knowledge and understanding of AML/CFT legislations, regulatory trends and developments in Singapore, knowledge and understanding of the AML/CFT environment in Singapore and international trends and typologies, knowledge and understanding of how to carry out risk assessment and conduct various types of customer due diligence, familiarity with ACRA Guidelines for RFAs and awareness of how ACRA’s Compliance review and inspections impact RFAs.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 7: Demystifying DNA: Understanding Forensic DNA Evidence in Criminal Defence
events.outline:
How is DNA extracted, analysed, and used in court? In this seminar, forensic experts break down the science behind DNA profiling—from hair, bodily fluids, and beyond—and explain how this evidence can shape legal outcomes.
Gain practical insights into lab processes, interpreting DNA reports, and how to effectively work with forensic experts in criminal cases.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Large Firms – Business Planning, Marketing and Client Development
events.venue: Organiser The Law Society of Singapore
events.outline: Large law firms must balance growth, client expectations, and internal alignment. This session, combining College of Law Australia's practice management expertise with Singapore practitioner insights, explores aligning strategic plans with practice priorities, targeted marketing, and client development. It examines strengthening client relationships, addressing complex needs, and enhancing market positioning, viewed through Singapore's evolving legal landscape, offering practical strategies for scaling sustainably while preserving quality and trust.

events.title: [WEBINAR] International Arbitration In Practice 2026 - Session 3: Working with Third Parties: Co-counsel and Experts
events.outline: This session explores practical considerations in managing relationships with local counsel, foreign lawyers, barristers, and expert witnesses in international arbitration. Drawing on practitioners’ experiences, it examines cross-jurisdictional challenges, common pitfalls, and effective strategies. The session also covers engaging and instructing experts, including expert briefs, timelines, independence, conflicts of interest, and preparing useful expert evidence for international tribunals.

events.title: Lunchtime Conversations: Redesigning Legal Work for the Future
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This seminar is targeted at managing partners, general counsel, team leaders and HR professionals in law firms and in-house legal teams.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Introduction to Singapore Competition Law+
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This course will provide an overview of the key principles of competition law in Singapore. It will introduce participants to the underlying legal & economic concepts that underpin the statutory prohibitions against anti-competitive agreements, abuse of dominance and mergers. Each session will survey some of the landmark decisions of the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS), examine the relevant legislative provisions applicable & explore the broader policy implications.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 8: Criminal Defence in the Digital Age: Harnessing AI & Digital Forensics
events.outline:
Digital forensics and AI are reshaping the legal landscape—how should criminal defence lawyers adapt?
Join us for a forward-looking webinar exploring how cutting-edge tools like predictive analytics, legal AI (including ChatGPT), and digital forensics are transforming criminal defence work.

events.title: [WEBINAR] AI Meets ESG: What Legal Professionals Need to Know
events.outline: AI governance and ESG are converging rapidly, creating new legal risks, regulatory expectations and business opportunities. This webinar brings together regulators, governance experts and lawyers to examine how AI-ESG integration is reshaping corporate governance, sustainability reporting, carbon markets, digital infrastructure and disputes. Participants will gain practical insights into governance, regulatory compliance, contractual risk allocation and emerging liability issues.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Mediation Advocacy Skills+
events.venue: Webinar / 137 Amoy Street, Far East Square, #03-06, Singapore 049965
events.outline: This event is organised by Sage Mediation Institute for Leadership Education. As mediation gains prominence, advocates must stay updated and effective, not only in the courtroom but also at the mediation table. This workshop covers the thoughtful preparation needed for an advocate to prepare the client for an international mediation and how an advocate can engage effectively with counterparties and the mediator. Advocates who complete the full workshop may accredit themselves as IMI-Certified Mediation Advocates.

events.title: Valuation and Damages in International Arbitration+
events.venue: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge Campus)
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This course walks the participants through the key aspects of valuation and damages in international arbitration. The overarching objective of the course is to equip participants with the essential basic knowledge and skills to understand the different stages of the valuation process, so that they can plead or adjudicate more effectively and efficiently when there is a dispute over the value of an asset.

events.title: JLP - Translating Corporate Governance Principles into Legal Frameworks
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: This module is designed to equip junior lawyers with the skills to advise clients on corporate governance issues, and how to balance ethical considerations with the rights of relevant stakeholders, and to comply with the prevailing regulations.

events.title: SMU Yong Pung How School of Law Auditing Programme AY2026-27 Term 1+
events.outline: SMU Yong Pung How School of Law is pleased to invite members of the legal fraternity in Singapore and other interested parties to apply to audit selected LLB courses offered by the school. Participants are welcome to attend and observe seminars taught by our instructors. They are exempted from course requirements and a certificate of attendance will be awarded at the end of the course upon meeting the attendance requirements.

events.title: Prompt to Practice: A Launchpad for Exploring AI in Legal Work
events.venue: Members' Lounge (The Law Society of Singapore), 28 Maxwell Road, #01-03, Singapore 069120
events.outline: This hands-on workshop is designed for lawyers who are beginning to explore AI and want a practical, grounded introduction to what it can do for their practice.

events.title: JLP - Application Advocacy+
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Get equipped with essential skills to effectively prepare for and argue applications in court.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Community Law Training Programme 2026 - Module 8: Child Protection Proceedings
events.outline:
Child Protection Proceedings can be complex, urgent, and deeply impactful. Using a practical overview of how Care and Protection Order applications are handled in the Youth Court, and the role counsel can play in supporting families through the process.
Learn the key stages of proceedings, from first mention to social report hearings, family conferences, contested hearings, and appeals. Gain insight into common court orders, expectations of represented parties, and how legal assistance can help clients navigate emotionally charged situations with clarity and confidence.

events.title: [WEBINAR] AML/CFT/PF in Practice: Managing Client Risk, Red Flags and Reporting Obligations in Today’s Legal Landscape
events.outline: By the end of the programme, participants should be able to identify key AML/CFT/PF risks in legal practice, recognise common and emerging red flags, assess when enhanced due diligence or ongoing monitoring may be required, understand the practical considerations around STR filing, and appreciate the importance of proper documentation, internal controls and escalation within the law practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 9: Drug Offences & Forensics: What Defence Counsels Need to Know
events.outline: Understanding how drugs metabolise in the body can make or break a defence. This seminar equips criminal defence lawyers with essential knowledge on drug pathways, forensic testing, and interpreting HSA reports.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Sustainability Apex Programme Masterclass #10: ESG Tech and Data
events.outline: This masterclass provides an overview of ESG technology and data, examining how ESG data is collected, governed, and integrated to support sustainability reporting, assurance readiness, and decarbonisation efforts. It highlights key technology trends and governance considerations relevant to lawyers and compliance professionals advising on ESG disclosures, controls, and accountability.

events.title: Certificate in Wealth, Succession and Legacy
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This course provides an overview of the legal and practical considerations in wealth transition and succession planning. Participants examine how purpose and governance influence long-term family decisions, and review key estate-planning tools and structures. The module also explores philanthropic planning and the role of legal practitioners in supporting families through legacy, governance, and wealth-planning discussions.

events.title: [CALS] Stephen Brogan-Jones Day Legal Fellowship Lecture on the Rule of Law on Defensive Democracy: Assessing Taiwan’s Democratic Self-Defense Framework
events.venue: Yale-NUS Hall, Faculty of Law, University Town
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: Defensive democracy, developed by Karl Loewenstein after witnessing the rise of Hitler, holds that democracies may restrict anti-democratic forces from using democratic freedoms to destroy democracy itself. Germany adopts a militant model, while the United States permits restrictions only when there is a clear and present danger. Taiwan has adopted a middle-ground approach, and debate continues over whether it should strengthen its defensive measures.

events.title: Self-Leadership for Lawyers: Taking Charge of your Work Life - Module 1
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This session will introduce Mindful Business Singapore’s Lawyers’ Sustainability Report with the main focus being on its section on personal wellbeing for lawyers, to build Participants’ awareness of our human needs for thriving and developing greater awareness of their personal capacity to sustain their wellbeing and effectiveness.

events.title: [WEBINAR] International Arbitration In Practice 2026 - Session 4: Global Enforcement Strategies
events.outline: This session examines strategies for enforcing arbitral awards across Asia and against sovereign states. It explores procedural hurdles, sovereign immunity, investor-state enforcement challenges, and practical approaches to recovery. Participants will also gain insights into global asset tracing, cross-border enforcement coordination, forensic tools, freezing injunctions, disclosure orders, and other mechanisms used to identify and secure assets before they dissipate.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Converging or Diverging? New Developments in the Regulation of Digital Assets across the EU, Singapore, and the United States
events.outline: This webinar examines the rapid consolidation of digital asset frameworks in the EU, Singapore, and the US. Moving beyond a basic jurisdiction survey, the session provides a comparative analysis of key developments, including the EU’s MiCA, Singapore’s stablecoin regime, and the US GENIUS and CLARITY Acts. Participants will gain a structured understanding of the changing legal landscape.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Recent Developments in Family Law – Legislative Reforms and Therapeutic Justice in Singapore
events.outline: There have been many significant changes to Family Law legislation in recent years. This seminar seeks to provide an overview of the key changes, including the sixth fact relating to divorce, the new regimes and frameworks relating to enforcement of custody and access orders, maintenance enforcement, and the enhanced judge-led powers of the court. The speakers will also review the effectiveness of these changes in strengthening Therapeutic Justice elements in our family proceedings.
